name: Haramase King
source:
Surrounded on all sides by great powers, a certain kingdom has two princes. Kristof, the kind-hearted older brother who is loved by everyone. The prodigal younger brother, Yurius, is hated by everyone. 

When everyone thought that the older brother would be the heir to the throne, the hero, Yurius, noticed a rule that had been handed down in this kingdom for generations.

The heir to the throne is the princess of a neighboring kingdom.  Fortunately, the princesses of the neighboring kingdom were all beautiful girls. With never-ending training, corrupt and impregnate them, and seize the throne of the king!

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
某个王国四面楚歌，却有两位王子：深受众人喜爱的善良长兄克里斯托夫，以及人人憎恨的浪荡弟弟尤里乌斯。

当所有人都认为哥哥会成为王位继承人时，尤里乌斯却注意到了这个王国世代相传的一条规则。

王位继承人必须是邻国的公主。幸运的是，邻国的公主全都是美丽少女。通过无休止的训练，让她们堕落并怀孕，再夺取王位！

[来自[url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]官方网站[/url]]
